notes: Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/CLAS-ug.html and iah.ucsd.edu. Classical Studies is one B.A. major offered in two emphases: Language and Cultures. Language Emphasis requires 8 lower-division courses (three Greek LTGK 1-2-3, three Latin LTLA 1-2-3, plus two additional lower-division approved courses) and 12 upper-division courses / 48 units (six language-based, typically three LTGK 100-199 and three LTLA 100-199; plus six electives from the approved list drawn from at least two departments). All courses letter grade, C- or better. Correction applied: added MMW 121 to the upper-division approved electives (present on the catalog list, omitted in harvest); expanded the 'two additional lower-division courses' pool to the full approved lower-division list.

buckets.label: Latin foundational sequence
buckets.note: Three foundational Latin courses (or equivalent). Language emphasis requires BOTH the Greek and Latin sequences.

buckets.label: Two additional lower-division approved courses
buckets.note: Two additional lower-division courses chosen from the department's approved lower-division list.

buckets.label: Upper-division language courses (Latin & Greek)
buckets.note: Six language-based courses in both Latin and Greek, typically three LTGK 100-199 and three LTLA 100-199.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives (from at least two departments)
buckets.note: Six upper-division electives from the approved Classical Studies list, from at least two different departments. Language courses used to satisfy the six-course language requirement above cannot double-count here.
